rationale: FX03 says the BDC cost XBRL unit is not USD, but the flagged value is UNIT_USD. The raw schedule's cost and fair-value columns are dollar-denominated, with dollar signs on the same investment schedule totals and a related cost/fair-value summary marked amounts in thousands. The check is therefore misclassifying the USD unit label rather than identifying a source currency defect.
